label: Bigg's
note: Also called "transient" in older literature; see names.tsv.

label: Resident
note: The resident ecotype: fish-eating killer whales, containing the Northern and Southern Resident communities among others. Added by Q1.

label: Southern Resident
note: The community of J, K and L pods, within the Resident ecotype (SSA:0000003). Was also carried as an ecotype at SSA:0000001 until Q1 resolved the duplication; that identifier is deprecated to this one.

label: J clan
note: Southern Residents are believed to comprise a single acoustic clan. Needs expert confirmation.

label: J17s
note: J17 and her descendants, derived from NOAA's maternity records (ADR-0023). Anchoring every mother's line as a matriline is unconfirmed; if these prove too fine, this merges into its mother's. The matriline, distinct from individual J17. See ADR-0003.

label: L32s
note: L32 and her descendants, derived from NOAA's maternity records (ADR-0023). Anchoring every mother's line as a matriline is unconfirmed; if these prove too fine, this merges into its mother's.

label: J17
note: The individual, distinct from matriline J17s. See ADR-0003.

label: Orcinus orca
note: Tag this when an orca is heard but the ecotype is undetermined.

label: Lontra canadensis
note: Heard as splashing and short squeaks or chirps near shore stations.

label: Aves
note: Tag this when a bird is heard but cannot be resolved further.

label: Laridae
note: NCBI has no gull-only taxon below this family, which also includes terns; a gull heard on a hydrophone is rarely resolvable further anyway.

label: Sagmatias obliquidens
note: Genus unsettled. WoRMS accepts Sagmatias (AphiaID 1571909, checked 2026-08-13), NCBI labels the same record Aethalodelphis, and Lagenorhynchus is the familiar older name; all three are in names.tsv. The label follows WoRMS because it tracks the Society for Marine Mammalogy list; the taxon_id still points at NCBI per ADR-0008. A curator arbitrates in Q26; until then the label is a holding position and nothing keys on it.

label: Balaenoptera acutorostrata
note: Species level. North Pacific animals are the subspecies B. a. scammoni, which no hydrophone distinguishes.

label: Enhydra lutris
note: Unlikely to be heard on a hydrophone, but sighted: iNaturalist holds ~200 verifiable Salish Sea observations, which SalishSea.io ingests. See docs/scope.md.

label: Kogia breviceps
note: Not reliably distinguishable at sea from K. sima (SSA:0000923); a sighting identified only as Kogia is a genus-level record this register cannot yet receive. See the open question in the pull request that added this row.

label: Kogia sima
note: See SSA:0000922.

label: Delphinus delphis
note: iNaturalist and NCBI both place the long-beaked form as a subspecies of this species rather than as D. bairdii; SalishSea.io holds records under both the species and D. d. bairdii.

label: Cetacea
note: Tag when an animal is known to be a whale, dolphin or porpoise but nothing narrower is supportable.

label: Otariidae
note: Sea lions and fur seals together. Not interchangeable with 'sea lion': Callorhinus ursinus (SSA:0000933) and Arctocephalus townsendi (SSA:0000932) are here too.

label: Pinnipedia
note: Crosswalked to iNaturalist's 372843 as a closeMatch, not an exactMatch, and deliberately. iNaturalist labels that taxon 'Pinnipeds' and returns Otariidae beneath it, but the name Phocoidea strictly denotes the true-seal superfamily, and NCBI has no Phocoidea at all. Pinnipedia is the clade actually meant; salishsea-io decision 027 records the same misnomer. The two concepts overlap in practice and differ in principle, which is what closeMatch says.

label: Lutrinae
note: River otter (SSA:0000906) and sea otter (SSA:0000918) are both present in the region, so a bare 'otter' is genuinely ambiguous rather than shorthand.

label: Balaenoptera
note: Rorquals. Named for the group rather than for a species: the register holds four Balaenoptera species and NCBI counts eleven, so any species name here would claim more than a genus-level identification supports.

label: Callorhinus
note: Monotypic: C. ursinus (SSA:0000933) is the only species, so the genus and the species denote the same animal and share a common name.

label: Delphinus
note: Common dolphins. NCBI counts six species; the name is the group's, not D. delphis'.

label: Enhydra
note: Monotypic: E. lutris (SSA:0000918) is the only species.

label: Eumetopias
note: Monotypic: E. jubatus (SSA:0000902) is the only species. The commonest genus-level identification in consumer data -- observers report a sea lion without separating Steller from California.

label: Lontra
note: New World river otters. NCBI counts four species; only L. canadensis (SSA:0000906) occurs in the Salish Sea, so 'River otter' is honest here and shares the species' name deliberately.

label: Megaptera
note: Monotypic: M. novaeangliae (SSA:0000901) is the only species.

label: Mirounga
note: Both elephant seals. Only M. angustirostris (SSA:0000917) occurs here, but the genus name stays at genus level.

label: Orcinus
note: Monotypic: O. orca (SSA:0000900) is the only species. Note this is the GENUS; an ecotype is not a taxon and is recorded separately (ADR-0008).

label: Phoca
note: NCBI counts four species. Deliberately NOT 'Harbour seal': P. vitulina (SSA:0000904) is one species of several and a genus-level record does not support naming it. Distinct from SSA:0000937 Phocidae ('True seal') and SSA:0000938 Pinnipedia ('Pinniped'), which sit above it.

label: Phocoena
note: NCBI counts five species. Not 'Harbour porpoise': P. phocoena (SSA:0000912) is one of them.

label: Tursiops
note: Bottlenose dolphins. NCBI counts ten species under the genus; the name is the group's.

label: Zalophus
note: NCBI counts three species. Not 'California sea lion': Z. californianus (SSA:0000903) is one of them. A Zalophus record is a sea lion, which is all it claims.

label: Delphinapterus leucas
note: A vagrant here, not a resident: minted because SalishSea.io holds a Whale Alert report of one inside the Salish Sea.

label: Eubalaena
note: Right whales. Whale Alert reports them at genus rank; NCBI counts three species.

label: Hyperoodon
note: Bottlenose whales. Whale Alert reports them at genus rank; NCBI counts two species.
